questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What kind of animal is an Orca?
A. A type of shark
B. A breed of fish
C. A type of dolphin
Answer: C. Orcas, although often known as killer whales, are actually the largest species of the dolphin family.
questions.de: Von welcher Familie der Zahnwale ist der Orca (Schwertwal) das größte Mitglied?
questions.en: Of which family of toothed whales is the orca, or killer whale, the largest member?

timeline.labelEn: Carl Linnaeus scientifically describes the orca
timeline.labelDe: Carl von Linné beschreibt den Orca wissenschaftlich

questions.notes: Confirmed: largest member of the oceanic dolphin family (Delphinidae). 'Dolphin family' on the card means the oceanic dolphins, not river dolphins.

questions.cardText:
[Literature] Who is the author of “1984” and “Animal Farm”?
A. Aldous Huxley
B. George Orwell
C. J.R.R. Tolkien
Answer: B. George Orwell, whose real name was Eric Arthur Blair, chose his pen name based on his love for England and its countryside. “George” was inspired by the patron saint of England, while “Orwell” was taken from the River Orwell in Suffolk, a place he loved.
questions.de: Unter welchem Pseudonym schrieb Eric Arthur Blair „1984“ und „Farm der Tiere“?
questions.en: Under what pen name did Eric Arthur Blair write “Nineteen Eighty-Four” and “Animal Farm”?

timeline.labelEn: Life of Eric Arthur Blair, better known as George Orwell
timeline.labelDe: Leben von Eric Arthur Blair, bekannt als George Orwell

questions.notes: Confirmed, including the pen-name origin (Saint George, River Orwell in Suffolk). Animal Farm 1945, Nineteen Eighty-Four 1949.
